sample: Original frozen Hotpot50, no selection changes
primary: Latest QA budget q=.90 versus fixed112, same ranker; fixed32/64/full/old adaptive retained from original results
diagnostics: Every generated step, layer and KV-head; 95% teacher attention mass is a proxy, not an answer-quality guarantee

interventions.selection: Union of all F1 disagreements among existing full/fixed32/fixed64/fixed112/old-adaptive/new-adaptive
interventions.repair95: Increase only deficient per-head budgets to first original budget bucket meeting 95% full mass with frozen ranking, on each intervention state

restrictions: No training, calibration, new data, or replacement of existing artifacts; oracle repair is diagnostic only
